# attachment-assert-tool

> Region-based pixel assertions for PDFs, images and documents. Name rectangles on a reference file (a template), then compare the same regions of a candidate file pixel by pixel. Usable from pytest-playwright (fixture `attachment_assert`), @playwright/test (`expect(download).toMatchAttachment(template)`), Python, and a CLI.

## Docs
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): full guide for AI agents: install, creating templates, Python and TypeScript Playwright recipes, options, report format, pitfalls, repo map
- [README.md](README.md): human-oriented usage, UI walkthrough

## Examples
- [e2e/python/test_downloads.py](e2e/python/test_downloads.py): pytest-playwright fixture usage
- [e2e/python/test_async_api.py](e2e/python/test_async_api.py): async Playwright Download
- [e2e/node/downloads.spec.ts](e2e/node/downloads.spec.ts): @playwright/test matcher usage
- [examples/templates/invoice/template.json](examples/templates/invoice/template.json): template format

## Source
- [attachment_assert/compare.py](attachment_assert/compare.py): comparison engine and public Python API
- [js/index.d.ts](js/index.d.ts): Node API types
- [js/playwright.d.ts](js/playwright.d.ts): matcher types
